summary: Iteration 25 - Photo redesign (upload jewelry photo -> mark up -> AI render -> quote) + crafting brief on leads. Backend: 11/12 pytest pass (1 real bug: non-image snapshot -> 500); leads-list assertion fixed in test and verified manually. Frontend: full customer flow on 390x844 works end-to-end (build header button -> /redesign -> upload via file chooser -> draw + note -> Render (~15s) -> result with compare toggle -> send -> sketch-sent). Admin lead detail shows PHOTO REDESIGN / Redesign of customer's photo / Price to be quoted / Customer's photo with mark-up; crafting brief saves ('Saved'), persists after reload, 'Crafting brief updated' note, desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x844 OK. Found and FIXED one UI bug: drawn strokes were invisible on web (hidden under the background photo). 3 AI sketch generations used in pytest + 1 in UI. All TEST leads bulk-deleted (14).

minor.issue: Non-image snapshot (e.g. text/plain bytes or HEIC that PIL can't decode) with design='' -> 500 Internal Server Error (PIL.UnidentifiedImageError in _square, server.py:461-468, called outside try at line 501). Should validate content and return 400 'Please upload an image'.

sketch_id that does not exist (and no design/product) -> 200 creating a junk lead with kind 'product', product null, price 0 (server.py:580-601). Should 404 'Sketch not found' when sketch_id lookup fails.
Sketch docs carry no tenant_id; any tenant's quote can reference any sketch_id (ids are 32-hex random so low risk).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: strokes were not visible while drawing on uploaded photo - background photo wrapper is position:absolute, Svg was static so it painted under the photo on web. Added position:absolute/top/left to Svg style (src/components/sketch-pad.tsx:77). Verified strokes now render red over photo; undo works.

issues: Store title truncates to 'Gado Jewe...' because of the new 'Redesign a photo' pill
After save the button shows 'Saved' but at 0.5 opacity (disabled because not dirty), so the confirmation looks greyed out

action_items: POST /api/sketches: wrap _square/_composite image decode in validation and return 400 for non-image uploads (currently 500)
POST /api/quotes: return 404 when sketch_id is provided but not found instead of creating a 'product' lead with null product
Build header: avoid truncating store name on 390px (icon-only or shorter label) and make redesign button >=44pt tall
Optional: show 'Saved' at full opacity on brief-save-button; sketch-pad icon buttons to 44pt
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_sketch: _square runs before the try block, so PIL decode errors become unhandled 500s
create_quote: sketch_id branch sets p=0 before verifying the sketch exists
requestSketch always sends mimeType image/jpeg for uploaded photos; backend relies on PIL decode (HEIC on iOS may fail without pillow-heif if picker returns HEIC)

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12; failing test is a real 500 bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows pass after stroke-visibility fix

seed_data_creation: TEST leads created and all bulk-deleted; a TEST_iso_* business created via /api/auth/signup for tenant isolation check (left in place).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, so module fixture uploaded_sketch may run once per worker (AI cost). Test image: /app/test_reports/angle_images/*.png (JPEG 1024x1024); crop to non-square to verify square padding. Lead list response key is 'leads'.
rca_of_issue: Stroke invisibility: in sketch-pad.tsx the background <View position:absolute> precedes a static <svg>; in CSS positioned elements paint above non-positioned ones regardless of DOM order, so on web the photo covered the strokes (native unaffected). Fix: make Svg absolutely positioned.
